summary: Saint Catherine of Siena was a mystic and reformer whose writings and prayer led many to a deeper life of faith. She is remembered for wisdom, courage, and love of the Church.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Catherine of Siena as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Catherine of Siena, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
